verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a laptop processor, not a software product that can be invoked headlessly or in a CI pipeline, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers hardware performance, AI engines and companion toolkits such as OpenVINO and oneAPI. None of it shows the chip itself shipping a headless or CI automation mode, so the exception that would make the axis apply is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
